context.surface: An experimental cipher derives keys from a caller-supplied scalar and ancillary attributes.
assumptions: Use synthetic inputs in a local test harness.

review.invariant: Changing a documented key input changes the derived key in the reviewed fixtures.
review.verification: Compare derived keys for distinct synthetic key inputs while holding ancillary attributes fixed. Retain a repeatability control.

source_observation.summary: The baseline returned the same key for distinct scalar inputs in the reviewed fixtures. The repaired local regression passed.
